source.note: single-card witness of the removal:permanent stem (the removal supergroup at PERMANENT breadth — any permanent type, broader than removal:creature/removal:artifact). Oracle: 'When this artifact enters, destroy target permanent. When this artifact is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, return it to its owner's hand.' The witness is line-0's destroy. Live engine (portRows, spans [26,52]) projects emit:destroy (family=destroy, tier=Green, stem=null) — the ADR-2 shadow projection does NOT yet map destroy → removal:permanent (stem is null on all 55 emit:destroy rows), the Stage-3 engine-catch-up gap. But the destroy PARSES faithfully: the AST is EffectType=destroy on Target.Filter.CardTypes=['permanent'] (byte-identical effect node to the committed HandParsedCards/UMA/AngelOfDespair.json and UgintheIneffable.json 'destroy target permanent' fixtures). The gold hand-maps that parsed AST to removal:permanent — a faithful witness, not a wish. No edhrec_rank in the testbed source — popularity omitted (not fabricated).

Spine of Ish Sah.note: incidental card context — 'When this artifact enters' — the self-ETB subscription that fires the destroy. Live engine projects consume etb:artifact:self (family=etb, isSelf=true). Not the witness; the S0 → S1 (ETB fires destroy) binding is card-defined/internal, not an inter-card edge.

THE WITNESS — 'destroy target permanent' — a permanent leaving play by destruction, at PERMANENT breadth (Filter.CardTypes=['permanent'], no card-type narrowing — genuinely removal:permanent, not removal:creature/removal:artifact). from=battlefield (a destroyed permanent moves off the battlefield, CR 701.7a); manner=destroyed (EffectType=destroy → the 'destroyed' rung of the manner axis); to=graveyard is derived (destroy sends to the owner's graveyard, CR 701.7a, but regeneration/replacement can alter the destination → over-approximated, caps Reliability); control=any ('destroy target permanent' has no Controller restriction — the target may be any player's permanent). Live ADR-2 label: emit:destroy (stem=null; the destroy→removal:permanent stem-map is the Stage-3 shadow-projection gap).

assertions.because: S1 projects the removal supergroup at PERMANENT breadth — destroy target permanent (Filter.CardTypes=['permanent'], any permanent type, broader than the already-witnessed removal:creature/removal:artifact children). Turns the scaffold-declared removal:permanent stem declared → witnessed. Already declared, so NOT unpredicted.
removal = a zone-change whose FROM endpoint is play; a destroyed permanent leaves the battlefield (CR 701.7a). from axis, licensed_by removal:*.
EffectType=destroy maps to the 'destroyed' rung of the manner axis (enum includes destroyed; licensed_by removal:*) — the manner distinction from the sacrificed/blink siblings.

destroy sends the permanent to its owner's graveyard (CR 701.7a), but a regeneration or 'if it would be destroyed/die, exile/... instead' replacement (CR 614) can redirect the destination — the parser cannot prove to=graveyard, so it is over-approximated and caps the port's Reliability (a Rest-in-Peace / replacement prune).

'destroy target permanent' imposes no Controller restriction on the target (Filter has no Controller) — it may hit any player's permanent. control axis lattice self ⊆ controlled ⊆ any; the widest, any.
